players.product: EC axial / centrifugal fans for data centers

quarterly_data.signal: At the OCP Global Summit 2026 in the U.S., Sunonwealth (SUNON) officially launched new liquid-cooling products for servers and AI applications - five core products: standard cold plates and DIMM cooling supporting Intel / AMD server platforms; customized liquid-cooling solutions; a 3D-printed cold plate it is exploring with 3D Architech as future research; an In-Rack CDU (L2L / L2A) for lab validation through high-density AI racks; and an In-Row CDU combining its HVAC fan technology. The company says it now has a complete liquid-cooling product line.
